faqs.question: What is a Segmented Email Gateway?
faqs.answer: Unlike a standard inbox, a segmented gateway acts as a secure airlock for your digital identity. By using a structured address format—combining your Identity, Type, and Route segments—you gain granular control over your mail. Our gateway intercepts messages sent to these segments (e.g., user_shopping@), verifies them against your security permissions, and only then routes them to your vault.

faqs.question: How does Duotail differ from other email forwarding providers?
faqs.answer:
Duotail is active security infrastructure, not a passive forwarder. We differ in two fundamental ways:
1. Email Handling: While traditional services just pass mail through, our Segmented Gateway uses a whitelist-first architecture to block unverified senders at the protocol level before they even reach your inbox. We also support full bidirectional communication, so you can reply to any email without exposing your true identity.
2. Privacy Standards: Most forwarders can read your mail. Duotail is a Zero-Knowledge system where your data is **cryptographically isolated**. Because your keys are derived from your secret words in your browser, it is mathematically impossible for us to access your content. Read our full Privacy Practices to see why we are a world leader in respecting user sovereignty.

faqs.question: Is my personal email address exposed when using your service?
faqs.answer: Never. Your destination email is stored behind an encrypted layer. When you reply through Duotail, the recipient sees only your Duotail Identity. We strip all originating metadata, including your IP address and device headers, ensuring your true address remains invisible.

faqs.question: Do you store my emails?
faqs.answer: We only persist processed emails in a zero-knowledge state using industry-standard cryptographic primitives (including X25519 and AES-256). Because we do not persist the decryption keys, your messages are mathematically inaccessible to everyone—including us and government entities. To further minimize your digital footprint, all encrypted records are automatically and permanently purged from our infrastructure after 30 days. You also maintain the power to manually delete any record at any time via your dashboard.

faqs.question: Can I use this for standard, unrestricted email forwarding?
faqs.answer: No. Duotail is built for intentional communication. We are a 'Whitelist-First' gateway. If a sender is not in your permitted circle, the email is rejected. This architecture prevents your inbox from ever becoming a target for automated spam or harvesting bots.

faqs.question: What happens if I discontinue any of my Duotail email addresses?
faqs.answer: The connection is severed instantly. To protect your privacy, our gateway 'Black-Holes' (silently drops) any incoming mail to non-existent or disabled aliases. By not sending a 'Bounce' notification, we prevent spammers from verifying if your address is active.

faqs.question: Do I need to configure anything in my personal email account?
faqs.answer: Zero configuration is required on your existing Gmail, Outlook, or private server. You simply provide Duotail with your destination address, and our infrastructure handles the encryption, metadata stripping, and routing automatically.
